prompts.name: pumpkins
prompts.subject: A small low cluster of three uneven orange harvest pumpkins, one carved jack-o-lantern with a friendly angular face and subtle amber interior, one small pale pumpkin, a few dry curled leaves and a little straw at their feet. A single cohesive little ground prop, not a full pumpkin field.
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent sprite for Crownlands medieval strategy map. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its elevated three-quarter atlas view, fine dark brown ink outlines, hand-painted watercolor/gouache shading, earthy ochre/moss/brown palette and grounded medieval materials. Create ONE compact Halloween scenery vignette. It will be shown at 40 to 65 pixels tall on a game map so keep a strong readable silhouette and simple larger details. Daylight lighting from upper left, subtly warm orange lantern light, no dramatic lighting or bloom. Fully transparent background and ample transparent margin, no rectangular ground tile, no backdrop, no text or lettering, no UI or circular badge. No trees, rocks, city, characters or large scenery beyond the subject requested. Keep the rustic look of the reference; avoid glossy 3D, neon, modern objects, bright plastic, ornamental game-icon frames. prompts.name: scarecrow
prompts.subject: A small rustic scarecrow on a wooden cross stake, floppy straw hat, worn faded plum and ochre patchwork tunic, straw hands and a pumpkin head with simple triangular eyes. Two little orange pumpkins and a tiny handful of straw at the foot. Static harvest decoration, not a living person. Compact triangular silhouette, no extended thin details.

prompts.name: lanterns
prompts.subject: A short crooked weathered wooden post with a hanging iron candle lantern, two orange pumpkins at its foot, a small worn wooden crate and a few straw stalks. Medieval harvest Halloween decoration. One carved pumpkin has subtle amber interior light. Compact composition, the post is only twice as tall as the pumpkins, nothing grand or tower-like.
